commands.name: inspect_player_rig
commands.description: Inspect the player's body and first-person materials, walking bob, editable finger joints and hand poses. Supply a target pose to retrieve its authored clip.

commands.name: preview_player_rig
commands.description: Preview player shell/joint colors and walking bob, or a keyframed hand clip for the selected pose. Clip offsets are additive wrist movement within ±0.12 m and rotations within ±60 degrees. Joint rotations are additive to the built-in pose. Keep pose keys at [0,0] and match loop endpoints. Open palm plays when the player interacts.

commands.name: save_player_rig
commands.description: Save the current player rig draft across sessions.

commands.name: discard_player_rig
commands.description: Discard the player rig draft and restore the saved player colors and animations.
